import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 262144;
    static int L, n, k, Mo, len, bit[] = new int[20], fac[] = new int[MAXN], inv[] = new int[MAXN], cnt[] = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] g = new int[20][MAXN], f = new int[20][MAXN];
    static long[] h = new long[20], p = new long[20];

    static int qpow(int base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) result = (result * b) % Mo;
            b = (b * b) % Mo;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    static void add_mod(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] = (x[0] + y) >= Mo ? x[0] + y - Mo : x[0] + y;
    }

    static void sub_mod(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] = (x[0] - y) < 0 ? x[0] - y + Mo : x[0] - y;
    }

    static void FWT_transform(int[] a, int length) {
        for (int size = 1; size < length; size <<= 1) {
            for (int start = 0; start < length; start += size << 1) {
                for (int offset = 0; offset < size; offset++) {
                    add_mod(new int[]{a[start + offset + size]}, a[start + offset]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void IFWT_transform(int[] a, int length) {
        for (int size = 1; size < length; size <<= 1) {
            for (int start = 0; start < length; start += size << 1) {
                for (int offset = 0; offset < size; offset++) {
                    sub_mod(new int[]{a[start + offset + size]}, a[start + offset]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void compute_log() {
        p[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            p[i] = h[i] * i % Mo;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i - 1; j++) {
                p[i] -= p[j] * h[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo;
            }
            p[i] = p[i] % Mo * inv[i] % Mo;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            h[i] = (p[i] + Mo) % Mo;
        }
    }

    static void compute_exp() {
        p[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            p[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                p[i] += h[j] * p[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo;
            }
            p[i] = p[i] % Mo * inv[i] % Mo;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            h[i] = p[i];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        L = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        Mo = sc.nextInt();

        int total = pwr(k, L);
        if (L % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(total);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % Mo);
        }
        inv[L] = pwr(fac[L], Mo - 2);
        for (int i = L - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % Mo);
        }

        for (int s = 1; s <= L; s++) {
            cnt[s] = cnt[s ^ (s & -s)] + 1;
        }

        n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (((L >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                bit[++n] = 1 << i;
            }
        }

        len = 1 << n;

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (((i >> (j - 1)) & 1) == 1) {
                    s += bit[j];
                }
            }
            g[cnt[i]][i] = inv[s];
        }

        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)(Mo - Mo / i) * inv[Mo % i] % Mo);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            FWT_transform(g[i], len);
        }

        for (int s = 0; s < len; s++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = g[i][s];
            }
            compute_log();
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = h[i] * k % Mo;
            }
            compute_exp();
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                f[i][s] = (int) h[i];
            }
        }

        IFWT_transform(f[n], len);
        int answer = (int)((long)f[n][len - 1] * fac[L] % Mo);
        answer = (total - answer + Mo) % Mo;
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int pwr(int base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) result = (result * b) % Mo;
            b = (b * b) % Mo;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }
}
